title.zh: 排序与大 O · 增长的形状
title.en: Sorting & Big O · The Shape of Growth

desc.zh: 算法之间的差别不在能不能排，在比较次数如何随数据量增长。冒泡、选择、归并、快排、计数排序的每个计数都由真实代码当场数出——连大 O 的形状，都是从实测表里拟合出来的。
desc.en: Algorithms differ not in whether they sort, but in how their comparison counts grow with n. Bubble, selection, merge, quick and counting sort — every count produced live by real code, and the Big O shapes fitted from the measured table itself.
